{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking bay 5662''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in the [[Laertos Spaceport]]. Inside, along the south wall, was [[maintenance storage locker 13A1]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] used the locker&mdash;codenamed [[Drop Point: Laertos]]&mdash;as a [[drop point]] and equipment cache during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}} {{C|"Operation Nighthook Drop Points" capsule}}</ref>
